findings.text: follow-on: llm_health_check now returns _probe_local_endpoint_models(section) whenever is_explicit_free_local_endpoint(get_model(section)) is true, and the code CLI passes model_section='discovery-score' (cli/discover/code.py:236). The panel therefore reflects only the local-free score seat. The code pipeline's relevance gate is served by a different seat, discovery-relevance (typesafe/jev-1.13 over the openrouter decisions endpoint, is_explicit_free_local_endpoint False), and nothing probes it. TRIGGERING INPUT: run `imas-codex discover code` while the decisions endpoint is unreachable but the ambix router is up -- llm_health_check('discovery-score') returns (True, host) because GET http://98dci4-gpu-0003:18802/v1/models answers 200, so the panel reads llm up while every relevance decision fails. This is a coverage narrowing, not a regression: the prior code probed the LiteLLM proxy, which was also not on that path, so the change is strictly an improvement to the local lane and silent on the decisions lane. Worth one line in the fragment or a second probe if the panel is meant to reflect the whole relevance path.

follow-on: (nit) the reviewed run's gate log header misnames its own revision. The first line of logs/gate-discovery-core-llm.log reads '# revision: 756c979eee8e798b9ed371ea9b679985834c9022', which is the reviewed run's BASE sha, on a line whose tree annotation reads '(head arm, repaired)'. The reviewed manifest's after_suite.revision is likewise the string '026ff560b0+f261e9b20+5401e28d7', a concatenation of three short shas rather than a revision a reader can `git rev-parse`. TRIGGERING INPUT: `head -1 .../gate-discovery-core-llm.log` beside `git -C <worktree> rev-parse HEAD` -- they disagree, so a reader trusting the header would date the green gate to the pre-repair commit. The substantive result is sound: I reproduced 2471 passed EXIT=0 at the repaired head 46848512d, and the new tests do not exist at the named base, so the gate can only have run at the repaired tree.

follow-on: (nit) _render_score(value) returns '-' for any non-int/float, so a path dict that omits the 'score' key now renders '-' where the prior `p.get('score', 0)` rendered '0.00' for the same input. The docstring calls the value 'unscored' and conflates two distinct cases: a key present carrying None (the crash the node fixed) and a key absent altogether. TRIGGERING INPUT: _render_score({'path':'a'}.get('score')) is _render_score(None) is '-', identical to the None case, so the two are indistinguishable in the progress line. No behavioural harm -- a '-' is a better rendering in both cases -- flagged only because the docstring claims one meaning for two causes.

item_verdicts.goal: the relevance-live-repairs node's goal is the three defects a live JT-60SA run exposed on the §25 relevance path: the decisions validator refused a legitimate rounded distribution, scan_worker crashed formatting an unscored path, and the status panel reported llm down while every code-discovery call was served. llm.py scales the probability tolerance to the offered criterion count; workers.py renders an unscored path as '-' via _render_score/_scan_progress_message; services.py probes a local-free seat at its own /v1/models with a 10 s timeout and the CLI passes discovery-score.
item_verdicts.manifest: present and self-consistent (status complete; commits 26ff560b0, 5401e28d7, f261e9b20, 46848512d; gate log and negative-control log named; a negative-control note; blockers none), with two record-quality blemishes: the gate log header names the base revision, and after_suite.revision is a concatenation of three short shas.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares nine write paths; the four-commit diff touches exactly eight of them (the declared docs/figures/jt60sa-discovery-completion/relevance-live-repairs directory carries no file) and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: The repairs are the durable shape for their scope: the tolerance is derived from the offered criterion count (0.005 per criterion, plus 1e-9) rather than a widened magic number, so it tracks the model's two-decimal rounding instead of being retuned; the health probe reads the seat's api_base from get_model_config rather than a literal, so a serve rotation that moves the route is followed; and the progress line is extracted into testable helpers that accept an unscored path by construction. Deductions: the health panel narrows to the local-free seat and stops reflecting the decisions seat the relevance gate actually calls, so a jev outage is invisible; and the probe swallows every exception into a False with a truncated message, which is correct fail-closed behaviour for a status panel but hides the distinguishing cause beyond a 60-80 character trim.
justifications.evidence: Strong and independently reproduced. I re-ran the full gate at the reviewed head (2471 passed, 11 skipped, 5 deselected, EXIT=0) matching the reviewed record exactly; the negative-control log shows the declared mutation red (EXIT=1, the 0.99 assertion failing at the fixed 0.01 tolerance); an independent probe confirmed all three behaviours (base f-string raises TypeError on None, head _render_score(None) == '-'; 0.99 and 1.03 accepted at head but refused under the fixed 0.01 while 0.90 stays refused; discovery-score is local_free=True with api_base http://98dci4-gpu-0003:18802/v1); and a live GET to that endpoint returned HTTP 200 with a models list, so the mocked-only probe behaves as the tests assume. One deduction: the gate log's first line names the base revision, so the receipt does not itself carry the revision it ran at.
justifications.fit: The added symbols are mechanism-named (_render_score, _scan_progress_message, _probe_local_endpoint_models) and the docstrings are rewritten in place in the file's own register; the commits are conventional with bodies, carry no plan or ticket identifier in the message, the symbol names or the comments, and no AI attribution. The CLI change is a one-word seat switch whose reason is stated in the commit body. Deduction: the gate log header and the after_suite revision string are recorded in a form a reader must repair before they mean anything.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node does what §25's live-repairs dispatch asked, one repair per named defect, each with a reproduction and a test. The tolerance scales with the criterion count so an eight-way choice at 0.99 or 1.03 is accepted and one at 0.90 refused; scan_worker renders an unscored path as '-' instead of raising; llm_health_check probes a local-free seat's own endpoint and the CLI passes discovery-score, the seat its code-discovery calls actually use. One deduction: the panel now reports only the local-free seat, so the decisions seat that gates relevance is not covered, which is a narrowing of what the status line means.
justifications.reuse: Good. _probe_local_endpoint_models reuses get_model_config and _format_load_detail rather than re-deriving the host label or the URL-parse, and it follows the file's existing urllib-based probe idiom (the SSH and embed probes use the same request style); the health check is composed from the existing is_explicit_free_local_endpoint predicate rather than a string test; the decisions validator change touches one comparison and its comment, leaving the shared DecisionsValidationError path intact; and the progress line reuses the existing on_progress callback shape by extracting the message builder from scan_worker. No new dependency or parallel mechanism was introduced.
